Game Overview

Meera Quest is a adventure title where join Meera in an exhilarating anime adventure through a monster-filled labyrinth. Maneuver skillfully across eight dynamic levels, using your double jump to dodge spikes and lava. Collect vital keys to unlock escape routes, skillfully navigating a visually captivating world that intensifies with each thrilling challenge. Ready for the quest?
